tasks.gr7-visual-literacy-persuasive-texts-t3: Topic: Visual literacy and persuasive texts. Cover advertisements, posters, persuasive language, target audience, and layout. Ask Grade 7 learners to identify slogans and hooks, analyse audience-purpose choices, and evaluate how visual design supports persuasion.
tasks.gr7-drama-continued-novel-study-t3: Topic: Drama or continued novel study. Cover dialogue, stage action, conflict, theme, and character response. Ask Grade 7 learners to identify speakers, interpret dramatic or narrative evidence, and connect conflict events to wider themes.
tasks.gr7-project-language-refinement-t3: Topic: Project and language refinement. Cover project writing, active and passive voice, punctuation, and clauses. Ask Grade 7 learners to select planning steps, transform voice accurately, and choose edits that improve sentence clarity and correctness.
